shared_elements: massive block-like stone sculpture carved in the round
simplified head with schematic facial features
shallow incised/low-relief surface detailing on a monolithic body
heavily weathered stone surface displayed in a museum setting
justification: Both are monolithic, heavily weathered stone carvings whose bulk is left as a solid block, with only shallow incised or low-relief detail marking features such as eyes, brows and body contours. The decisive difference is subject and axis: A is a horizontal quadruped animal seen in profile with legs and muzzle, while B is a vertical anthropomorphic column with a head, folded arms and discs/rings incised across its front, so the placement of elements corresponds hardly at all.
